{{Quote|Ne makao?''"<br />"''J'na ke floo, Murra.|Murra and another Ysanna shaman react to having their Force powers blocked by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Dark Empire II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Murra''' was a [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] tribesman on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] who aided [[Okko]] in an attempt to defeat [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]] when they first arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
